condition: dayjs.duration() given an ISO 8601 string with a leading '-' sign (e.g. '-P1D', '-PT1H') ignores the sign and returns a positive duration, which breaks round trips of negative durations through toISOString().
workaround: Strip the leading '-' yourself, parse the rest, then negate the result, e.g. dayjs.duration(-dayjs.duration(s.slice(1)).asMilliseconds()).
